sourceHierarchy: Executable services/constants/contracts at pinned main > bounded handoff/release docs > historical designs/README. Local experimental adviser is explicitly separate.

films.title: BUILD AN EMPIRE
films.flywheel: Actions -> skills and assets -> materials/crafting/trade -> Crew capability -> Family control and business income -> upkeep, rivals and law -> reinvestment / consequence -> legacy.
films.secondary: Show garage, kitchen, skills, NPC relations, market, loans, races, boxing, casino, property, politics and megaprojects as labeled screenshot constellations around the main cause-and-effect story. Cash never auto-converts to OMR.

films.title: THE ECONOMY HAS TERRITORY
films.flywheel: Defined/funded OMR access -> useful spends -> Desk recycling and existing-inventory sales; separately funded cash redemption; canonical market activity -> explicit fee recipients/Core; designated Turf LP fees -> funded Family rights/siege -> prospective ownership. Bonds, LP commitments, NFT and RWA rails are bounded side loops.
films.secondary: Keep a four-way currency legend: GAME CASH / OMR / ETH / APPROVED RWA UNITS. Show the recycling loop and two distinct fee paths. Smaller named cards cover backing, prizes, Store/pass, staking/status, bonds, finite inventory, City distributions and RWA custody.

films.title: THE CITY REMEMBERS
films.flywheel: Permitted clue -> investigation -> independent evidence/knowledge -> collaborative preparation -> authorized contribution/approval/execution -> committed state -> authored Director response -> available opportunity -> new investigation.
films.secondary: Agent callouts identify READ / PROPOSE / YOU CONFIRM. Different participant screens demonstrate asymmetric information. Use a real committed history receipt and actual resulting opportunity; do not promise every action creates one.

economyVoiceover:
Cash builds the empire. OMR follows a different circuit. Defined missions and funded rewards put it in reach. Spend it on upgrades, services and status. Spent tokens return to the Desk: existing inventory, sold again.

The Window turns OMR into game cash, within its funded limits. Cash cannot buy OMR.

On the canonical ETH-OMR market, sell fees support development, community, RWA funding and protocol-owned liquidity.

Core liquidity and seasonal Turf are separate. Families contest future Turf fees. Sieges allocate funded escrow. The principal stays with the protocol.

Inventory bonds sell funded OMR over time. Liquidity commitments use funded rewards. Eligible gear and vehicles can move onchain. Approved RWA purchases can reach eligible Street Deed vaults.

Every balance has a source. Every move has a cost.

OMERTÀ. The economy has territory.
